raw_response:
Alright, let me think through this year's plan...

---

I'm 51, been doing this wheat-maize rotation for most of my life on this piece of land. 16.9 mu isn't a lot — my wife and I manage most of it ourselves, and our kid works in town so sends a bit back but doesn't help in the fields much anymore. Every yuan I spend on seed and fertilizer has to come back at harvest, so I don't gamble.

**Winter wheat** — I planted this back in early October, so it's already in the ground and through the winter. Right now (late April) it's heading, so what's left is the spring management. I put down compound fertilizer (复合肥) as base before planting, about one bag (40 kg) per mu, which gives me roughly 15 kg N. Then I topdressed urea at jointing in late March — another half bag per mu or so, maybe 8 kg N. The extension guy at the township station keeps telling us to split more and use less total, but I stick close to what works. I'll irrigate once more before harvest if it stays dry — we had the returning-green irrigation and jointing irrigation already. Wells are metered now, costs me around 30-40 yuan per mu each time, so I don't water extra. Expecting around 450 kg/mu if nothing goes wrong. Harvest early-mid June.

**Summer maize** — goes in right after wheat harvest, no time to waste. I'll no-till direct seed with a hired planter (秸秆还田 + 免耕播种, about 40 yuan/mu for the service) — everyone does it this way now, the wheat straw gets chopped and left. Hybrid seed, Zhengdan or Denghai variety, whatever the seed shop has, around 50 yuan/mu. I put compound fertilizer in with the planter, then topdress urea at the big trumpet stage (大喇叭口期). If it doesn't rain in July I'll irrigate once, maybe twice. Aiming for around 500 kg/mu. Pesticide — I spray herbicide after planting (乙草胺/atrazine mix), and I'll watch for corn borer (玉米螟) around tasseling and spray once if I see damage.

Total cash I'll put out is around 10,000 yuan across both crops. Tight year like any other.
